Caála|Rec da Caála]]}} | longest wins = | longest unbeaten = | longest winless = | longest losses = | matches = 240 | total goals = 533 | prevseason = [[2012 Girabola|2012]] | nextseason = [[2014 Girabola|2014]] }} The '''2013 [[Girabola]]''' was the 35th season of top-tier football in [[Angola]]. The season ran from 26 February to 3 November 2013. [[C.R.D. Libolo|Recreativo do Libolo]] were the defending champions. [[Kabuscorp S.C.P.|Kabuscorp]] were crowned champions having won their first title.{{cite web |url=http://www.portalangop.co.ao/angola/en_us/noticias/desporto/2013/9/41/Kabuscorp-crowned-champions-Girabola2013,58edd250-56d5-4de5-90aa-beeda6e774d2.html |title=Kabuscorp crowned champions of Girabola2013 |publisher=ANGOP.com |date=7 Oct 2013 |access-date=15 Sep 2015}} The league comprised 16 teams and the bottom three were relegated to the 2014 [[Segundona]].
